title: The Book
prompt: A man breaks into a woman's house and murders her. When he sees the book she was reading, he regrets having killed her. Why?
solution: The man is a hitman who has killed several times for money. This time he killed the woman because she had been present at one of his murders and could identify him. The book she was reading was in Braille: she was blind and could never have recognized him, so he regrets killing her.
